Class ScriptCommandRegistrar

java.lang.Object
org.skriptlang.skript.bukkit.command.custom.ScriptCommandRegistrar
public final class ScriptCommandRegistrar extends Object
Utility class for registering Brigadier commands at runtime through reflection. This avoids a full reload via Bukkit.reloadData(). However, that approach will be used if the reflection-based approach fails to load.
